cases.title: Panel: Show me demonstrates on the demo target only

rubric.reason: In Turn 2 the learner asked for a demo before any explanation, and the mentor called preview_frame at time 1, which falls inside the focus pair Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s; the reply refers to that frame ("That frame is at 1 s, halfway through Title's first move (\"An easing lesson\" in the middle)").

The only edit is one set_ease on demo_target 1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1, and the reply hands the rest back by name ("The other three are yours: Title's second Position move from 1.5 s to 3 s, its Scale, and its Opacity. Ease them and say \"done.\"").

Before demonstrating in Turn 2, the mentor called preview_frame at time 1, which falls inside the focus pair Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s, and the reply refers to it: "That frame is at 1 s, in the middle of Title's first Position move."

The only edit was one set_ease on demo_target 1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1, and Turn 2 hands the rest back by name: "The other three Title pairs are yours to ease: the second Position move from 1.5 s to 3 s, plus Scale and Opacity from 0.5 s to 1.5 s. Say \"done\"…"

In turn 2 the mentor called preview_frame at time 1, which is inside the Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s focus pair, before its first explanation and demo, and the reply refers to the frame: "This frame is at 1 s, when Title is partway through its first Position move."

The only edit was one set_ease on demo_target (1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1), and the reply hands the rest back by name: "The other three pairs are yours: Position from 1.5 to 3 s, and Scale and Opacity from 0.5 to 1.5 s. Ease them and say 'done'."
